data.body:
Operator decision (2026-11-17): land logging on the visibility poll AND run the live delete-permission probe repeatedly in production Jira to reproduce the flake.

Conditions on the live runs:
- Every Jira issue the probe creates must have a summary that names it as a disposable probe artifact (e.g. a "[rebar probe - safe to delete]" prefix) and a description that says it can, and should, be deleted if it is still present after testing finishes.

REQUIRED BEFORE CLOSING THIS TICKET: explicitly clean up every probe-created issue from BOTH Jira and rebar. That covers issues the probe failed to delete and any copies the reconciler imported into the rebar store, including the earlier rounds REB-7248, REB-7249 and REB-7250 if any remain. Record on this ticket the list of issue keys created, and confirm that each one is gone from Jira and from rebar. Do not close this ticket until that confirmation is recorded.
